title: MQTT broker
tlsKept: The hub has a secure (mqtts) address saved. This app version doesn't change it: the hub's secure connection isn't supported yet.
maskedHint: The hub has a login and password stored but doesn't show them. To save another address, type them again — otherwise the broker is saved without them.
restartHint: The hub connects to the new broker after a restart.
savedReboot: Broker saved on the hub. It connects after a restart.
failed: The hub didn't take the broker address: {reason}
invalid: Enter an address without spaces and a port from 1 to 65535.
passNoUser: A broker won't take a password without a login — enter the login.
